title: decode.rs: base64 pre-truncation to avoid full decode is worth defending
description: decode.rs pre-truncates the base64 input to max_b64_chars before decoding, avoiding allocation of a full decode buffer when only a preview is needed. The formula n.saturating_mul(4).div_ceil(3).next_multiple_of(4) correctly rounds up to the next 4-byte base64 group boundary, preventing spurious decode errors. The b64_input_was_limited detection (a second scan over body_bytes to find one more non-CRLF byte) is necessary because base64's 3:4 encoding means a full group may not indicate truncation. A contributor might suggest 'simplifying' by always decoding the full body — this would make preview operations O(body_size) in memory instead of O(max_bytes).
